basic_details.short_information: National Health Mission, Keralam has 49 contract vacancies open until 5 pm on 7 November 2026. The largest groups are Data Entry Operator with 7 posts and Lab Technician with 4, alongside finance, medical, IT, communication and public health roles. The upper age limit is 40 years for every post, and consolidated pay runs from Rs. 16,250 to Rs. 78,000 a month.

content_sections.heading: About NHM
content_sections.text: This recruitment comes from National Health Mission, Keralam, through its State Programme Monitoring & Support Unit at NHM Building, General Hospital Junction, Thiruvananthapuram. The State Health & Family Welfare Society (Arogyakeralam) handles the contracts and interviews, and the notice is issued by the State Mission Director (NHM).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee is Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and fifty only). Deposit it in the bank account below. Demand drafts are not accepted.

rows.event: Age and cut-off date for the upper limit

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on qualification, experience and performance in the interview. Incomplete applications are not considered for short listing. The posts are for immediate requirement, and the Society may prioritize interviews for different categories of posts based on its needs. On the recommendation of a selection committee, the Society may also ask candidates to demonstrate skills in the area or specialization concerned. Originals of documents may be required at the interview. Providing a reference, especially the names of superior officers from previous organisations, is described as ideal.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on contract, initially for three months. The Society may extend it at its discretion, based on performance and integrity. The successful candidate signs a contract with the Society in the format of Annexure-I, uploaded on the website. Posts are temporary during the period of operation of the Mission, with no claim for permanency of job or labour claims against NHM, DHS or the Government. Candidates must be willing to relocate anywhere in the State and to work in any District of Kerala decided by the Society. All selected candidates are governed by the NHM rules and regulations in force from time to time. Opportunities for advanced training will be available. Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Deposit the examination fee in the account given above and keep the receipt or counter foil. Apply through www.arogyakeralam.gov.in , attaching the receipt or counter foil to the application. Applications sent by any other route are not considered. Scan the documents listed below properly and clearly, and combine them into a single PDF file. Forward the PDF to [email protected] . Documents to send: Receipt, counter foil or print screen of the amount paid Copies of qualifications Copies of experience Candidates on deputation posts are expected to apply through proper channel. If that is not possible in time, they must produce a no-objection certificate from the employer at the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has the lowest educational requirement?
faq.answer: The Secretarial Assistant post asks for a Matriculate pass, along with shorthand at 80 wpm, typing at 40 wpm and 2-3 years of experience as an office assistant.

faq.question: Q2. Can a Plus two pass candidate apply as Lab Technician?
faq.answer: Plus two alone is not enough. The 4 Lab Technician posts also require a Diploma or certified course in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts pay Rs. 78,000 a month?
faq.answer: Assistant Programme Officer/Epidemiologist (TB) pays Rs. 78,000. Microbiologist - IRL pays the same to an MD Microbiologist, but Rs. 30,000 to a non medical candidate.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need to post a hard copy of my application?
faq.answer: No. The scanned documents go by email as one PDF file, and no physical copy needs to reach the NHM State office.

faq.question: Q5. Can I pay the fee by demand draft?
faq.answer: No. The Rs. 250/- must be deposited in the ICICI Bank account, and a demand draft will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first contract runs for three months. Any extension depends on the Society's decision, based on performance and integrity.

faq.question: Q7. Will I be posted in my home district?
faq.answer: The notice makes no such promise. Candidates must be willing to work in any District of Kerala as decided by the Society.

faq.question: Q8. How will I get the interview call letter?
faq.answer: The call letter and all other communication from the Society come only through email. Updates and announcements appear on the website, which should be checked regularly.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I call the office with questions?
faq.answer: The notice asks candidates to avoid phoning the head office as far as possible. The Society answers queries raised by email.
